h2. Alpha's Victory


Surrendering...? It's the wrong word.

Surrendering implies a loss. A defeat. A last resort, when more preferable options have failed. A giving up of what you had, of everything you wanted...

But she sees now.

How can she want for anything other than [i]this?[/i]

There was no surrendering to this beast, this wild-maned wolf that stalked the dockyards, that made abandoned warehouses its home. There was no giving in, to his claws, his teeth, his broad tongue, his indulgent laps. There was no losing to his thrusts, his grip, his snarls of delight as he finally slammed the knot home...

There was only delight.

Welcome delight, like one wandering in the desert for a single sip of water. Only instead of searching for a stream, she merely had to fall to her knees, and her water dripped from the tip of a twitching shaft. If there was a loss, it was a loss of the outside world, with its pains and worries and anxieties - in here, she only had to care about... [i]it.[/i]

All she had to do was kneel, and look up at the mass of fur and muscle and claw that stretched into the darkness of the warehouse, at the red eyes that gleamed hunger in the shadows. Open her mouth, and he would grasp her hair, in a grip tender and firm and unyielding. And she could paint her newfound affections across a shaft slick with pre and more, with her own scent and that of a dozen others. Its veins would be intricate patterns to trace with her tongue, the knot would throb so wonderfully as it swelled against her forehead. Its heat would make her sweat, its taste would make her pant, and as thick pre dribbled across her body, clinging to arms and breasts and fingers, slippery and hot, she would whine her plea to drink once more...

Ah, there is no surrender, she knows now. It's so wonderfully, plainly clear in her mind.

Because when you kneel before a beast like this...

Why would you wish anything else?
